blocks.content: Understanding key terminology is the first step toward mastering complex concepts in competitive examinations.

rows: Fixed definitions rooted in core subjects like Polity and History
Evolving terms originating from Current Affairs and Economic Surveys

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Mastering key terminology forms the foundation for both preliminary and main examinations.
Clear conceptual clarity on terms prevents elimination errors in objective multiple-choice questions.
Terminologies are frequently evaluated through match-the-following and statement-verification formats.
Accurate usage of technical terms significantly enhances response quality in descriptive papers.
Pay close attention to subtle distinction between closely related technical and constitutional terms.
Direct definition questions are frequently asked in preliminary papers of UPSC, State PSCs, and SSC exams.
Focus on recent current-affairs terminologies introduced in economic surveys and official government reports.
